subject: Kickoff: Solstice Labs vendor enablement & PO onboarding
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Solstice Procurement <procurement@solstice-labs.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 06 Nov 2026 09:17:00 -0800
Subject: Kickoff: Solstice Labs vendor enablement & PO onboarding

Hi Caroline / Solstice procurement team,

Thanks for choosing Redwood — excited to get Solstice set up so we can start routing POs and payments. To keep the onboarding tight, can you please provide the items below? If anything is sensitive, feel free to upload to the DocuSign link or your secure portal and share the link.

Required to create vendor record and enable POs/payments:
- Legal entity name and full remittance address (street, city, state, ZIP)
- Federal Tax ID / EIN (or foreign tax classification if outside the US)
- Completed W-9 (or W-8BEN for non-US entities)
- Remit-to email for invoices and preferred PO routing email
- ACH details (bank name, account number, routing number) OR wire instructions and beneficiary name
- A bank letter or voided check to validate account (PDF)

Optional but helpful:
- Contact for invoices (name, role, phone)
- Tax withholding or special billing notes
- Standard payment terms (Net 30, Net 45, etc.) and PO requirements

Attachments: I have included our supplier checklist for your reference.
[Attachment: Supplier_Requirements.pdf (pdf)]

Next steps: once we have the documents above, Markus will confirm account details with finance and we will issue a vendor code. Grace will confirm PO metadata and how POs should be delivered. Can you try to get these over by COB Tuesday (11/10)?

Thanks — Neha
Neha Kapoor | Procurement Program Manager
Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0198

From: Caroline Sun <caroline@solstice-labs.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Solstice Procurement <procurement@solstice-labs.com>
Date: Fri, 06 Nov 2026 11:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Solstice Labs vendor enablement & PO onboarding

Hi Neha — thanks for the clear checklist. Attached are the files you requested: W-9, the buyer intake we filled out, and a bank letter. A few notes below.

Attachments:
- W9_SolsticeLabs.pdf (pdf)
- Solstice_Buyer_Intake.xlsx (xlsx)
- Bank_Letter_Solstice.pdf (pdf)

Notes:
- Legal entity: Solstice Labs, Inc. — remit address: 221 Harbor Way, Suite 400, San Mateo, CA 94401
- EIN: 94-1234567
- ACH: First Harbor Bank, Acct # 443322110, Routing # 121000358 (ACH + wire OK)
- Primary AP contact: Tara Nguyen, Accounts Payable Manager (tara@solstice-labs.com / +1 650-210-3344)
- Our standard terms are Net 30. We can accept POs via email to procurement@solstice-labs.com or via EDI; please advise which format works best for Redwood.

Question: Do you provide a vendor code so we can reference it on our invoices? Also, is a signed MSA required before first invoice? We have an executed MSA on DocuSign (I can share ID) but happy to re-sign if Redwood needs a specific template.

Thanks — Caroline
Caroline Sun | Head of Finance Ops
Solstice Labs

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 06 Nov 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Solstice Labs vendor enablement & PO onboarding

On Fri, Nov 6, 2026 at 11:42 AM Caroline Sun <caroline@solstice-labs.com> wrote:
> Hi Neha — thanks for the clear checklist. Attached are the files you requested: W-9, the buyer intake we filled out, and a bank letter. A few notes below.

Thanks — received. I will validate the EIN and bank letter with Finance (two-person verification) and confirm routing info. A couple of items we should close out before enabling ACH:
- Confirm the bank letter is on bank letterhead and includes an account verification line (looks good from preview but will confirm)
- Confirm the invoice remit-to email (they listed procurement@solstice-labs.com; request we also have an AP contact copied on invoices — Tara is fine)
- Confirm whether the MSA on DocuSign references Redwood's redwoodinference.com address (if not, we should have the Solstice legal team countersign our standard MSA)

Neha / Grace: can you (1) add Solstice to our vendor portal as a pending vendor, (2) assign the temporary vendor code, and (3) mark payment terms as Net 30 pending final MSA? I will ping legal if we need counter-sign.

Markus
VP Finance Operations | Redwood Inference

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Caroline Sun <caroline@solstice-labs.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 08 Nov 2026 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Solstice Labs vendor enablement & PO onboarding

Caroline — appreciate the quick turnaround and the attachments; we've got what we need to proceed.

What we've done so far:
- Created temporary vendor record in portal (Vendor code: RDW-002874)
- Marked payment terms Net 30 (pending signed MSA)
- Sent bank letter + EIN to Finance for verification (Markus is tracking)
- Shared DocuSign MSA link with Legal for counter-sign (please expect a DocuSign request if necessary)

Next actions for Solstice:
- Please confirm you are happy for Redwood to reference Vendor code RDW-002874 on your invoices
- If you prefer, complete the DocuSign acknowledgement for the W-9: https://app.docusign.com/solstice/w9-ack-12345

Once finance confirms the bank letter/EIN, we will enable ACH for RDW-002874 and notify you with payment remit instructions. If anything changes with remit address or bank details, please reply and flag "URGENT" in the subject.

Thanks again — looking forward to kickoff.
Neha
Procurement Program Manager | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Supplier_Requirements.pdf (pdf)]
